transcript.content:
1	version: 2
2	
3	models:
4	# Intermediate
5	  - name: specialty_mapping
6	    description: >
7	      Maps Medicare specialties to the NUCC taxonomy, deduplicating Medicare specialties by prioritizing the most specific specialty. 
8	      It joins the Medicare specialty crosswalk data with the NUCC taxonomy, ensuring that Medicare specialties are appropriately matched 
9	      or otherwise defaulting to NUCC specialization or classification where necessary.
10	
11	    columns:
12	      - name: taxonomy_code
13	        description: "Taxonomy code from the NUCC taxonomy."
14	        tests:
15	          - not_null
16	      - name: medicare_specialty_code
17	        description: "Medicare specialty code, prioritized to ensure only one specialty per provider taxonomy code."
18	        tests:
19	          - not_null
20	      - name: description
21	        description: >
22	          Cleaned description of the specialty. Based on Medicare provider supplier type description where available, 
23	          otherwise defaults to NUCC specialization or classification.
24	        tests:
25	          - not_null
26	
27	  - name: taxonomy_unpivot
28	    description: Unpivot provider taxonomies from NPPES data
29	    columns:
30	      - name: npi
31	      - name: taxonomy_col
32	      - name: taxonomy_code
33	      - name: switch col
34	      - name: taxonomy_switch
35	
36	
37	  - name: provider
38	    description: >
39	      Combines provider details from the NPI source table with their primary taxonomy and associated specialty. 
40	      It provides a comprehensive view of the provider, including business practice location details, taxonomy, and specialty.
41	
42	    columns:
43	      - name: npi
44	        description: "National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the provider."
45	        tests:
46	          - not_null
47	          - unique
48	      - name: entity_type_code
49	        description: "The entity type code indicating whether the provider is an individual or an organization."
50	        tests:
51	          - not_null
52	      - name: entity_type_description
53	        description: "Description of the entity type based on the entity_type_code ('Individual' or 'Organization')."
54	        tests:
55	          - not_null
56	      - name: primary_taxonomy_code
57	        description: "The primary taxonomy code for the provider."
58	        tests:
